    parts = d.split("-")
    year = int(parts[0])
    month = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 6
    return year + (month - 1) / 12

industry = [(parse_date(d["date"]), d["label"], d["significance"]) for d in data["industry_milestones"]["data"]]
regulation = [(parse_date(d["date"]), d["label"], d["significance"]) for d in data["regulation_milestones"]["data"]]

        # Stem line
